project_info.color_palette: Soft beige, off-white, light gray, navy blue, charcoal black, warm wood

main_subject.detail: A curated clothing rack display featuring a light blue-and-white vertically striped long-sleeve button-up shirt layered over high-waisted beige trousers in the left foreground, hanging from a black hanger on a wooden rail. To the right are multiple neatly spaced garments on black hangers: white striped shirts, navy striped shirts, beige trousers, olive trousers, and black trousers, arranged by tone in a premium retail closet setting.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic fashion merchandising photography, clean premium menswear retail styling, minimal showroom presentation, soft luxury catalog aesthetic

items: Top: a horizontal light wood clothing rail with silver hooks and closely spaced black hangers spanning the frame.
Left Foreground: a striped button-up shirt with rolled cuffs hanging prominently over beige tailored trousers, forming a styled outfit set.
Center: several light striped shirts and darker navy striped shirts grouped together on hangers.
Right: a sequence of beige, olive, and black tailored trousers hanging vertically in a tidy gradient arrangement.
Center Background: warm beige built-in wardrobe wall panels with soft shadows and a clean boutique interior finish.
Upper Left Shirt Collar Area: small visible brand neck label reading 'BADASS'.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even diffused illumination, gentle fabric shadows, natural textile definition, warm upscale retail atmosphere, clean tonal separation without harsh contrast

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image as the primary reference to preserve exact garment arrangement, hanger spacing, and merchandising composition.
Use the source image as the product reference for all garments so stripe pattern, trouser cuts, and color sequencing stay accurate.
Preserve the small visible text 'BADASS' on the shirt neck label if the model can render it cleanly; keep it subtle and realistic.
Keep the image square and tightly framed on the rack display without adding people, extra props, or decorative graphic overlays.
Maintain the premium retail-showroom realism: soft warm interior light, clean wardrobe surfaces, natural textile folds, and organized color blocking.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square fashion retail merchandising image of a minimal menswear rack styling display. Show a built-in boutique wardrobe with warm beige wall panels and a horizontal light wood rail across the top fitted with silver hooks and black hangers. In the left foreground, feature a hero outfit consisting of a light blue-and-white vertically striped long-sleeve button-up shirt with rolled cuffs hanging over high-waisted beige tailored trousers. Keep a small visible neck label inside the shirt collar reading 'BADASS'. In the center and right sections, arrange multiple garments in a tidy premium color sequence: white striped shirts, navy striped shirts, beige trousers, olive trousers, and black trousers, all hanging neatly with realistic spacing and drape. Emphasize clean menswear styling, natural fabric folds, crisp tailoring, soft cotton texture, and a luxury showroom presentation. Technical style: photorealistic retail merchandising photography, soft indoor showroom lighting, even diffused illumination, warm upscale atmosphere, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
